name: Corazal Aflame
description: Fire burns Corazal and threatens to spread to the surrounding forest.
disable: DC 30 Nature check or DC 30 Survival check (expert) to douse flames or DC 32 Athletics check (expert) to smother flames; on the sixth successful check, the flames go out. Casting a non-cantrip water spell on the flames counts as one success.
routine: (1 action; fire) On its turn, the fire deals 2d8+13 fire damage to creatures in the grove, plus an additional 6 fire damage to Corazal and any creature within 15 feet of them (DC 29 basic Reflex save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Blaze
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches Corazal

Effect The flames blaze higher, dealing 2d12+13 fire damage to the triggering creature (DC 29 basic Reflex save). The hazard then rolls initiative.
